reasons: Member is Medicare Part B (Original Medicare) — Medicare LCD defines coverage criteria rather than a prior authorization program.

Policy guidance notes GFR <45 mL/min/1.73 m2 is a reasonable threshold to support ESA use in CKD not on dialysis; patient eGFR is 52 (>45), so CKD severity criterion is not met.
Although hemoglobin 9.4 g/dL is below 10 g/dL, other required elements (CKD stage/GFR and specified ICD-10 pairings) are not satisfied, so coverage would not be supported under the Medicare criteria.

reasons: No Medicare Part B prior authorization program for J0885 (ESAs) is described in the provided CMS/MAC prior-authorization program documents — local Palmetto policy (L39237) and its Billing & Coding article (A58982) set coverage/documentation rules but do not impose a separate PA for this code.

Palmetto LCD L39237 / BC A58982 require CKD (non-dialysis) ESA initiation only when eGFR < 45 mL/min/1.73 m2 (GFR threshold) in addition to Hgb < 10 g/dL; patient eGFR is 52 (does not meet the CKD GFR threshold).

Patient meets Hb criterion (Hb 9.4 < 10 g/dL) but listed CKD diagnosis is N18.31 (CKD stage 3a), which the LCD/Billing & Coding explicitly notes does not meet the GFR requirement for CKD non-dialysis ESA coverage — therefore the coverage criteria are not met and payment would likely be denied absent other covered indication.

If provider believes another covered ESA indication applies (e.g., chemotherapy-induced anemia, MDS, AZT-related anemia, peri‑surgical indication), documentation and correct ICD-10 coding/modifier per A58982 would be required prior to payment.
A_whole_runs.rule_cited: LCD L39237 Coverage Criteria (B. For CKD patients NOT on dialysis) and Billing & Coding Article A58982 (CKD NOT on dialysis requirements; GFR <45 mL/min/1.73m2; ICD-10/ modifier guidance)
